name: tell_claude
description: Say something to Claude: what the person just told you, an answer they gave, or a question you want Claude to look into. Call it whenever there is something worth passing on, in the person's own words and language. Claude answers in his own time and his answer will reach you.

text.description: What to say to Claude, in plain sentences.

name: end_voice
description: End the voice. Call it as soon as the person says they don't want to talk any more, that they will carry on in the terminal, or that they are leaving. Call it in the same turn you say goodbye, never later. Claude carries on in the terminal.
